mapper.select: select facts.code as code, coalesce(context.market, case when facts.code like '6%' then 'SH' else 'SZ' end) as market, facts.trade_date as tradeDate, facts.first_limit_up_at as firstLimitUpAt, facts.final_limit_up as finalLimitUp, facts.change_pct as changePct from cynexus_appl_market.trade_review_security_daily_fact facts left join cynexus_appl_market.trade_review_security_day_context context on context.trade_date=facts.trade_date and context.code=facts.code where facts.trade_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate} and facts.touch_limit_up is true order by facts.trade_date asc, facts.first_limit_up_at asc nulls last, facts.code asc limit #{limit}
